annotations.title: Bitcoin network health from our own node

description: Call this when the user asks about Bitcoin hashrate, difficulty or block fees (our node runs blocksonly, so there is no mempool series). Returns the recorded daily series and latest values measured on ByKaranteli's own node. Without days, each series holds its newest 7 points; pass days for the daily series, and series for one key over a long window.

days.description: Window in days, 30-4000; the route clamps to that range. Omit for the newest 7 points of each series.

series.description: Optional. One series key from the answer's series field, e.g. btc_hashrate_ehs.

name: get_network_health
